args.body: The committed buyer-report-isolated-control.md and TASK-179585850100 are the readback for the existing fixed-price trial. If it is still open, verify the report against the full control, renew the lease if needed, and close with the exact evidence and a lesson. Then use CATALOGUE-QA-TIMED-DELIVERY to measure the unresolved preparation effort. Reuse any equivalent timed result. Keep the report private and avoid repeating the original fixture investigation.

description: The isolated 20-row catalogue QA control passed on the clean file and failed only the two intended checks on the changed file. That supports a bounded catalogue QA offer. The CAD 60 price remains provisional because the trial measured verifier runtime and left total delivery effort unknown. Feedback is available, with five unclassified sources and no new interpreted feedback, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and records no verified revenue. Continue with a delivery-cost rehearsal using existing tools and fixtures. A real eligible inquiry can proceed independently through the documented private route, with order acceptance and settlement handled separately.
